create_GymEnv: create a GymEnv instance for the mjrl_point_mass-v0 MuJoCo environment
build_MLP_policy: build a Gaussian MLP policy with hidden layers of size 32x32 for the environment
train_NPG_agent: train a Natural Policy Gradient agent using train_agent with 10 iterations and 100 trajectories
visualize_policy: visualize the trained policy by running 5 episodes in exploration mode
create_QuadraticBaseline: create a QuadraticBaseline for the environment spec to estimate state value functions
